content:
Luís Sanhudo and Pedro Lucas Martins, from BUILT CoLAB, were two of the guest speakers at the seminar of the Post-Graduation in BIM coordination of ISEP – Instituto Superior de Engenharia do Porto, which took place on February 04 and 10.

In these sessions they had the opportunity to address two topics of relevance to BIM, namely “Scan-to-BIM based on AI” and “BIM Standardisation” and the performance of CT 197, coordinated by BUILT CoLAB.

Esta Pós-Graduação tem como objetivo a formação de profissionais BIM, com base uma aprendizagem especializada, direcionada para um perfil de Coordenador BIM, de forma a apoiar o setor AEC.
